rationale: DH-02 6H and DH-03 12H both cross-market survived on Binance USD-M price paths after DH-02 independently survived two disjoint Binance Spot periods. Phase4 tests whether the same frozen signals remain economically positive when exits are resolved at 1m granularity and actual historical USD-M funding cashflows are included.

signal_construction.complete_1m_to_15m: only complete UTC-aligned sets of 15 consecutive 1m bars

minute_execution.entry: same frozen next HTF open, represented by the 1m open at that timestamp
minute_execution.scan: consecutive 1m bars from entry timestamp until frozen max-hold exit timestamp
minute_execution.stop_gap: if minute open <= stop, exit at minute open
minute_execution.target_gap: if minute open >= target, exit at target price
minute_execution.max_hold: if neither stop nor target occurs, exit at the 1m open exactly 40 days after entry (160x6H or 80x12H)
minute_execution.missing_minute_policy: if a position's required execution path crosses a detected source gap, classify that trade EXECUTION_PATH_UNRESOLVED and exclude it from resolved sample; do not interpolate

funding_execution.source: official Binance USD-M historical fundingRate archives
funding_execution.long_position_cashflow: funding_return = -funding_rate for each eligible funding event
funding_execution.eligible_event: funding timestamp strictly greater than entry timestamp and strictly less than exit timestamp
funding_execution.event_equal_entry: excluded because position is not assumed established before funding snapshot
funding_execution.event_equal_exit: excluded because position is assumed exited at that timestamp
funding_execution.sum_method: arithmetic sum of funding returns over holding interval
funding_execution.application: add cumulative funding return to price gross return before transaction costs and R normalization

family_policy: Both 6H and 12H always reported; no post-outcome winner selection. A survivor supports historical funding-adjusted USD-M execution economics but does not authorize live trading.
